question: Was this injury event contact, non-contact, or indirect contact?

direct_contact.label: Contact
direct_contact.definition: Force was applied directly to the injured knee.

non_contact.label: Non-contact
non_contact.definition: No external contact was mechanically linked to the injury action.

indirect_contact.label: Indirect contact
indirect_contact.definition: Contact away from the injured knee remained mechanically linked to the injury action.
